---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or a change to an existing one.
title: "feat: <one-line summary>"
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## What you want

One paragraph, plain language. The user-facing outcome, not the implementation.

## Why it matters

Who needs this and what problem does it solve? Cite a sprint input log entry or a stakeholder (the Supervisor / the Superintendent / the Executive / vendor / supervised institution) if applicable.

## Scope / Part

Where does this fit the current scope? Flag it if it doesn't.

## Precedent

Cite a comparator from [docs/research/market-comparators.md](../../docs/research/market-comparators.md) if relevant. If no comparator exists for this idea, say so.

## Alternatives considered

What other shapes did you consider? Why did you propose this one?

## Out of scope

What this is explicitly NOT.

## Done looks like

How will we know it's complete? State the acceptance criteria.
